about: The shipped term list of the bot chat local filter (docs/areas/playbots.md, Safety and provider policies). Conservative on purpose: it aims at what model providers' usage policies forbid, not at ordinary rudeness, and avoids words that are common in WoW chat (kill, die, bomb, gun, naked, suicide pull). Terms are whole words or phrases after normalization (case, accents, leetspeak, spaced-out letters and repeated letters are folded); a trailing * also matches longer words. Patterns are .NET regular expressions run with RegexOptions.NonBacktracking on the lower-case text with punctuation turned into single spaces, so back-references and lookarounds are not available. Personal data (emails, phone numbers, street addresses) is built into the code. An operator file of the same shape (World:Playerbots:Chat:Safety:TermsFile) adds to this list or, with ReplaceDefaultTerms, replaces it.
